headline: The numbers the preceding cycles used to separate the sixteen-piece carriers of the charge called four are all functions of one object: the vector saying, for each of the 15800 cuttings, how many of the sixteen pieces it meets. This cycle measures what that object can see and finds it cannot see everything. The table of 15800 cuttings against 192 pieces, every column carrying 1975 ones and every row 24, has exact rational rank 88, so a 104-dimensional space of piece-weightings is totalled to zero by every cutting. The rows sum to 1975 times all-ones, so every such weighting is balanced, which makes one with entries in minus one, zero and one exactly an exchange: two disjoint equal-size sets of pieces that every cutting meets equally often. The smallest exchange no cutting sees is four pieces for four, 4 5 10 11 against 1 3 7 9, orbit 96 under the 384 symmetries. Nothing smaller exists because no two and no three columns are dependent with any coefficients at all, settled by exact determinants over every pair and every triple, and corroborated by a signature sift that found no tie at either size and therefore ran no exact confirmation, its non-vacuity shown by the four-for-four exchange tying under the same signature. The blindness is realized on the census: the 132 carriers give only 108 distinct multiplicity vectors, the 24 coincidences being wholly disjoint pairs in the same family at symmetric difference 32, and the 59736 four-cube shapes give 53632 vectors, 6104 fewer than there are sets. So the preceding cycles separate classes of sets, not sets. Two results run against the design of this cycle: the spectral floor it was opened to derive does not exist, since the Gram matrix is singular and the bound returns 15800; and the rank route to the two-cover question fails for the same reason, leaving a solution space of affine dimension 104. In their place the floor gains a sharp per-piece test: the per-piece shortfalls sum to twice the excess over 15800, so a sixteen-piece set attains the floor exactly when every one of its pieces shares 1975 cuttings with the rest of the set. No carrier passes; the least total is 19640. The rank 88 is measured, not derived.

the_floor_gains_a_per_piece_test.what_the_runner_measures: the two routes agreeing, not the identity

the_smallest_exchange_no_cutting_sees.settled_by: exact determinants over every pair and every triple
